title: Diagnosing Projection-and-Repair for Actionability-Constrained Decision-Tree Recourse: Public Artifact
description: Reproducible diagnostic benchmark for actionability-constrained single-tree recourse, version 1.1.0. Includes matched leaf/anchor budgets, restore-then-filter and segment-interval mechanisms, support and constraint-density sweeps, numeric-subspace DiCE random/genetic and constrained Growing Spheres, independent HiGHS checks, precision-aware actions, and repeated large-tree timings. Source benchmark datasets are accessed from their original providers and are not redistributed.
